entries.signature: PeriodPresentation(begin : date, end : date, format : string)
entries.description: A span of dates, as a report header reads it. A whole month is its English name and year, a whole quarter is Qn yyyy, a whole year is the year, a single day is that day, and any other span is the two days. format may be omitted. A format containing FP=False always answers with the two days. This is the 1C ПредставлениеПериода reading used on report headers.
entries.parameters:
begin — the first date.
end — the last date.
format — optional. FP=False keeps the two days.
